evidence.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.

In addition to the shares of Class A common stock sold in the initial public offering, Anthropic closed the concurrent sale of an aggregate of 313,253,007 shares of Class N common stock to Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Broadcom Inc., Google LLC, Micron Technology, Inc., Microsoft Corporation, NVIDIA Corporation, and TSMC Partners, Ltd. at the public offering price of $83.00 per share, in a private placement for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $26.0 billion.
Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share.
Shares in the frontier AI company behind the Claude chatbot, which floated in the US on Thursday, fell by 9% on Friday, ceding most of the gains from the biggest initial public offering in history.

Aggregate gross proceeds from the initial public offering, including the shares sold by the selling stockholders, and the concurrent private placement were approximately $119.5 billion, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses.

The Claude developer priced its IPO at $83 per share. By November 24, 2026, the stock had dipped to a range of $75.61 to $76.60, wiping out a first-day pop that once briefly pushed its valuation above $2 trillion.
